name: Glasgow Open 2027

venue.name: Woodside Hall
venue.details: Main Hall, Ground Floor, accessible from front main doors.

information: Everyone is welcome to compete in this competition, and all competitors are eligible to win medals for podium positions. However, if you are a newer competitor, you may be more interested in the [Glasgow Beginners 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowBeginners2027) competition. **PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Glasgow Beginners 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowBeginners2027). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowOpen2027#82796-series-competition-information). Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
